title: test/support/fake-mcp/records.test.ts:55-64: bl() builds the body with the wrong key order, so the Q6 digest cannot match

question: Q-001
reason: The repository settles it. test-plan.md § Constants defines Bl as JSON.stringify of { jsonrpc: "2.0", id, method, params } with id and params left out when null or undefined, and test-plan-legacy.md defines INIT(v) through Bl and gives the Q6 digest for that body. records.test.ts lines 55-64 build { jsonrpc: "2.0", method } then add id, so the key order deviates from the plan's builder. The spec requires the SHA-256 hex of the body as received, so no production change can make the digest match; only the test builder can. The clarifier suggestion restores the documented order and names the frozen file. I could not run the hash myself, but the suggestion is correct irrespective of the computed value because it aligns the test with the plan's definition.
